summary: Shadow/context-only committee read as of 2026-10-15: the US backdrop is MIXED (44), not an actionable risk-off signal. The meaningful deterioration is internal: leadership moved from INTACT to CRACKING, breadth is at the 14th percentile with a price divergence, liquidity is contracting, HY OAS widened roughly 40 bp over 21 days, and systematic flows are aligned cutting. Credit is the dominant Risk Radar scare, but the caution cell’s measured 21-session pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate (0.9x), so it does not establish a bearish edge. Rates remain restrictive: real 10-year yield is 2.88%, term premium is rising, and the curve is bear-steepening. At the same time, recession risk is off, financial conditions remain loose on their older observation clock, volatility is calm/normalizing, and two of three major indices retain uptrends. The correct interpretation is unresolved transition and fragile participation, not an originated position. Factor intelligence is immature: only 10 panel dates, the >=60-date floor is unmet, Pair G is dormant, no factor attention observations have been graded, and the composite is non-tradeable. The graded-spine sample returned was capped and dominated by unsigned-MFE board rows, so it cannot support a clean directional conclusion. A proposed leadership/credit/breadth persistence hypothesis was rejected as invalid because its metric was not in the gradeable registry; no hypothesis was registered or treated as evidence.
